'''The Maquis''' is the 21st virtual expansion for [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on June 27, 2014. The set consists of 58 cards (54 regular cards and 4 alternate image cards). This set is part of the ''Deep Space Nine Block'' consisting of cards from [[Emissary]], [[Emissary: Supplemental]], [[Warp Pack: Emissary]], [[The Maquis]], and [[The Gamma Quadrant]],
